Täitja kohustub oma kulul esindama tellijat lepingu alusel täidetavate ülesannete või toimingutega seotud kõigis vaidlustes (sh kohtuvaidlustes) kolmandate isikutega ning kandma kõik sellega kaasnevad menetluskulud. 7.7 Tellija võib lepingu üles öelda, kui Täitja rikub oluliselt õigusaktidest või lepingust tulenevaid kohustusi. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopo

V primeru nastopanja s podizvajalci, kjer ni neposrednega plačila, mora glavni izvajalec najpozneje v 60 dneh od plačila končnega računa oziroma situacije poslati naročniku svojo pisno izjavo in pisno izjavo podizvajalca, da je podizvajalec prejel plačilo za izvedene gradnje ali storitve oziroma dobavljeno blago, neposredno povezano s predmetom javnega naročila. V nasprotnem primeru naročnik Državni revizijski komisiji poda predlog za uvedbo postopka o prekršku iz 2. točke prvega odstavka 112. člena ZJN-3. Ponudnik v razmerju do naročnika v celoti odgovarja za izvedbo prejetega naročila, ne glede na število podizvajalcev, ki jih navede v svoji ponudbi. Naročnik v nobenem delu procesa obdelave osebnih podatkov ne dovoljuje izvoza podatkov v države izven Evropske unije in v mednarodne organizacije. Po zaključku pogodbenega razmerja na podlagi te pogodbe, je izvajalec morebitne osebne podatke v svoji posesti dolžan nepovratno uničiti oziroma vrniti naročniku, če ta to zahteva. Executive Order 14028, “Improving the Nation’s Cybersecurity” (E.O. 14028), emphasizes the importance of securing software used by the Federal Government to perform its critical functions. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. C.3 SCOPE The contractor shall provide the Library with new perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses and technical support for perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses—new or legacy— in its possession. This support includes the services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons with Alexa-enabled smart-speaker devices to use a voice-only user interface to search the NLS Catalog, manage their Wishlist, access BARD Lists, and stream audio content from NLS’s Talk

ontractor. Note— These scenarios are mutually exclusive. Consequently, 100% of the Library’s technical support for legacy licenses will be the same. My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

hall provide the Library with license and technical support. This support shall be provided on an annual basis at a firm-fixed price. This support shall be provided in blocks of 500. This support service must ensure that users with legacy RealSAM Dialog licenses can use the My Talking Books skill in production. The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine. RealSAM Legacy Dialog License Support with Auth Proxy and Streaming Servers hosted by the Library – same as scenario A, but the Library would host both the Auth Proxy service and Streaming Servers instead of the contractor.
